visible_strengths: The paper grid and real window remain distinct media and depth planes.
The eye direction, file contact and repeated gate make a comprehensible comparative moment.
Portrait appearance remains recognizable as guidance with substantial face presence in the environmental view.
visible_limits: The left fingertip uses the side margin, not the planned lower margin.
Fictional espionage is a plausible genre reading, but visible material could also read as archival or investigative research. Allegiance, secrecy, intent or truth are not proved.
Window mullion partially crosses the live gate but the diagonal crossbar and separate outside plane remain recognizable.
One paper frame contains an umbrella-bearing figure; that representation does not prove a past actual event.
